_STATUS: F&O holidays for 2026 are OFFICIAL, taken from NSE circular NSE/FAOP/71777 dated 2025-12-12. Everything else is not: the cash-segment holiday list comes from a separate circular that has not been read, and no circular consulted states session timings. The engine therefore still reports UNVERIFIED_CALENDAR for ordinary trading days.
_rule: An unofficial or disputed entry can only make the engine more restrictive. OPEN and PRE_OPEN require (a) an official holiday list covering that date for that segment AND (b) a session window marked source=official. A special session whose timings are not officially known yields UNSUPPORTED_SESSION, never an assumption of regular hours.

still_needed.why: No circular read here states regular, pre-open or closing session timings. The values below are the widely published ones and are marked unofficial.

sources.retrieval_note: nseindia.com's own HTML pages did not answer automated retrieval on 2026-10-19 (two 60s timeouts). The nsearchives.nseindia.com PDF endpoint did answer, which is how the F&O circular was obtained.
